g.text: RILIM: 5.56 A nominal; MODE open latch-off.

g.desc: RILIM: 5.56 A nominal; MODE open latch-off.

g.text: Q2 source returns to IN_SYS, not ground.

g.desc: Q2 source returns to IN_SYS, not ground.

g.text: F1 is backup protection; U1 limits load current.

g.desc: F1 is backup protection; U1 limits load current.

g.text: CdVdT: ~9.0 ms 10-90% at 12 V; ~0.50 A into 470 uF.

g.desc: CdVdT: ~9.0 ms 10-90% at 12 V; ~0.50 A into 470 uF.

g.text: Source contract: 4 A continuous / 5 A short peak.

g.desc: Source contract: 4 A continuous / 5 A short peak.

g.text: SHDN open: internal pullup. Reset overload by input power cycle.

g.desc: SHDN open: internal pullup. Reset overload by input power cycle.

g.text: Protected rail: 10.4-13.2 V normal; path <=0.4 V at 4 A.

g.desc: Protected rail: 10.4-13.2 V normal; path <=0.4 V at 4 A.

g.text: Native PGOOD and IMON unused. MODE open = latch-off.

g.desc: Native PGOOD and IMON unused. MODE open = latch-off.

g.text: Bounded faults: +24 V DC and -14 V DC. No automotive surge class. TVS intentionally DNP.

g.desc: Bounded faults: +24 V DC and -14 V DC. No automotive surge class. TVS intentionally DNP.

g.text: RESET is named PGOOD_12V: high means rail valid.

g.desc: RESET is named PGOOD_12V: high means rail valid.

g.text: 0.8 V adjustable UV; active-low open-drain RESET; 2% hysteresis.

g.desc: 0.8 V adjustable UV; active-low open-drain RESET; 2% hysteresis.

g.text: CTS and CTR/MR open: fastest device modes.

g.text: Flags: external source and feeds through F1/Q1.

g.desc: Flags: external source and feeds through F1/Q1.

g.text: Locate near amplifier later; do not duplicate on Sheet 6.

g.desc: Locate near amplifier later; do not duplicate on Sheet 6.

g.text: PGTH = GND: every recovery uses dVdT.

g.desc: PGTH = GND: every recovery uses dVdT.
